answer: The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. A juniper of per-task receipts records who did what, and the plume of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the raven of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
